SELECT e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count
FROM event_history e
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.ROOT_NE_ID = n.NE_ID
WHERE n.HOST_NAME = 'CiscoA' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') AND e.EVENT_TIME < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
GROUP BY e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME;

SELECT 
    bcd.CUSTOMER_NAME, 
    td.device_name
FROM 
    t_bz_config_customer bcd
JOIN 
    t_gn_topo_device td ON bcd.CUSTOMER_ID = td.customer_id
WHERE 
    td.device_status = 'down' 
    AND td.UPDATE_TIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) AS customer_count FROM t_bz_config_customer WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_devices FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root WHERE IS_DELETED = 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root 
WHERE IS_ONLINE = 1 
AND ONLINE_TIME >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') 
AND ONLINE_TIME < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01');

SELECT 
    eh.EVENT_NAME AS 告警类型,
    eh.EVENT_TIME AS 告警时间,
    eh.ALARM_REC_TIME AS 恢复时间
FROM 
    event_history_sdwan eh
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ci ON eh.ROOT_NE_ID = ci.NE_ID
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_customer cu ON ci.CUSTOMER_ID = cu.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE 
    cu.CUSTOMER_ID = (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root WHERE CI_ID = <指定设备CI_ID>) -- 请将<指定设备CI_ID>替换为实际的设备CI_ID
    AND eh.ALARM_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);
